subject: Parking gate sensor malfunctioning
description:
The main parking gate sensor at the entrance has been malfunctioning since yesterday evening. It intermittently fails to detect vehicles, causing the gate to close prematurely. This is a safety hazard and needs immediate attention.

Affected area: Main entrance gate
First noticed: May 16, 2026 around 8:00 PM
Frequency: Every 5-10 vehicles

messages.author: Sarah Johnson
messages.body: I've noticed the gate has been acting up for a couple of days now. The sensor seems to lose detection capability after a few hours of operation. Restarting the system temporarily fixes it but the issue returns.

messages.author: Support Team A
messages.body: Thank you for the detailed report Sarah. We've identified this as a known firmware issue with the gate controller v2.1.3. A firmware update is available. I'll schedule a remote update for tonight at 2:00 AM.

messages.author: Support Team A
messages.body: Internal note: Coordinate with on-site maintenance to ensure gate is manually operable during the firmware update window.
